title: Chapter 378 - 378 Receiving Da Mi Group; Welcome! (2)
content:
Chapter 378 - 378 Receiving Da Mi Group; Welcome! (2)

Chapter 378 - 378 Receiving Da Mi Group; Welcome! (2)

378 Receiving Da Mi Group; Welcome! (2)

At this moment, the phone in Lin Fan’s pocket rang.

He looked at the caller ID and saw that it was an unknown number from Jingbei.

Lin Fan did not hesitate and answered the call.

“Excuse me, are you Mr. Lin Fan?” The voice on the other end of the phone was clearly not fluent in the language of Hua Nation.

When Lin Fan heard this voice, he immediately knew who it was.

It was the CEO of Da Mi Group, Leibs!

That was because Lin Fan used to watch Leibs’ live broadcast speech often.

“You’re CEO Leibs, right? I’m Lin Fan,” Lin Fan said.

“Mr. Lin, you’re really amazing. You guessed me right away,” said Leibs excitedly.

Lin Fan thought to himself, ‘With your half-baked language, it’s hard not to guess!’

“Thank you, Mr. Lin, for your trust in our Da Mi Group. You’ve directly purchased 51% of the shares, allowing us to have more funds and thus obtain better development opportunities.”

Even though that was what Leibs said, in reality?

His heart was bleeding and filled with regret.

Back then, in order to develop the company, he had no choice but to dilute and sell a large number of shares.

It was not easy for him to develop Da Mi Group into a company that was influential in Hua Nation today.

In the end, Leibs suddenly realized that 51% of the company’s shares had been collected by someone else.

More than half of the shares!

This was equivalent to the company that he had founded completely becoming someone else’s.

As long as the other party wanted to, he could easily replace him as the CEO.

Lin Fan randomly came up with a reason and said, “I only made a small investment. It’s because you’re capable that Da Mi Group is doing well.”

He could only say this.

Even if he said it out loud, Leibs would not believe it.

“Thank you for your praise, Mr. Lin.

“Our Da Mi Group has just moved into a new building. I wonder when you’ll be free? Can you come and give us some guidance?

“In addition, we still need your approval for our future plans.”

“Review the plans and guide the company?” Lin Fan asked. “There’s no need for that. The reason why I invested in Da Mi Group is because I believe in your abilities.

“Therefore, everything should still develop slowly according to the direction you set.”

When Leibs heard this, his face revealed a look of unconcealable joy.

Da Mi Group was his blood and sweat.

In his eyes, it was like his own child.

Leibs had already laid out a very complete route for the development of Da Mi Group.

He believed that as long as he followed this path, Da Mi Group would eventually become a first-class enterprise that stood at the top of the world!

However, if this major shareholder, Lin Fan, suddenly intervened and made changes…

If it was just a small change, it would be nothing.

However, if the core was changed, what would happen to Da Mi Group?

This was something that Leibs had always been worried about.

Now, he could finally relax.

However, Leibs still had a regretful tone as he said, “Then I can only follow your instructions and slowly develop.”

Even though Leibs did not sound happy, how could Lin Fan not tell what was the true situation?

However, he did not care too much about it.

Every time Leibs did a live broadcast, Lin Fan could easily feel his love for Da Mi Group.

Lin Fan continued, “I’m not far from Da Mi Group’s building. I’ll go and take a look inside.”

“That’s great!” Leibs said excitedly. “I’ll go downstairs to welcome you!”

As for welcoming him…

Lin Fan was not really interested.

However, he remembered that the security guards did not know him at all.

What if he was not allowed to go upstairs later?

In addition, he was not familiar with Da Mi Group’s office building at all, so he did need a guide.

“Alright.” He nodded.

After hanging up the phone, Lin Fan walked slowly toward Da Mi Group’s office building.

As for Leibs, he was busy.

He hurriedly walked out of the office and said to the very capable male secretary outside the door, “Quick, inform all the management level above P7 to line up and gather on the first floor of the building as soon as possible!”

In the eyes of outsiders, Leibs was an entrepreneur who would joke around.

In the eyes of the male secretary, Leibs was a steady, calm, and capable man.

The male secretary had never seen Leibs so anxious before.

What exactly happened?

The male secretary did not dare to hesitate at all and hurriedly said, “Yes, Sir!”

Then, he quickly dialed a number.

The next moment, a large group of men and women in suits and leather shoes stopped what they were doing and rushed downstairs.

Moreover, under Leibs’ arrangements, they all stood neatly.

This scene caught the attention of all the employees.

Qiao Shiya was one of them.

A few months ago, due to Qiao Shiya’s poor performance at the Internet Conference, she was forced to leave.

She was fired from the company.

After that, she had no choice but to look for a new job in Jiangbei.

However, all the major internet companies in Jiangbei attended the conference.

After seeing Qiao Shiya’s performance, they naturally would not choose to accept her.

As for some small companies, the pay was low and the workload was high. Qiao Shiya tried to work for a period of time, but she could not persist at all.

Qiao Shiya hesitated for a long time. In the end, she still chose to come to the capital.

In Jingbei… she was a completely new face.

At the same time, the overall salary and benefits far surpassed the jobs in Jiangbei.

After spending a long time preparing, Qiao Shiya successfully entered Da Mi Group.

At this moment, Qiao Shiya also noticed the movement in the hall on the first floor. She could not help but ask in puzzlement, “Why do I feel like a lot of leaders have gone downstairs?”

Beside her, a man wearing black glasses said, “I just received news that all the management levels above P7 in the company were dispatched.”

Qiao Shiya was quite good-looking, and the black-rimmed glasses man had always had feelings for her.

Therefore, he directly told her what he knew.

“All of them?” Qiao Shiya was even more confused.

The black-rimmed glasses man said, “Yes, look… Director Huang, Director Liu, and Director Lei all went down.”

Then, they watched as Leibs personally instructed the leaders above level P7 to line up.

Seeing this scene, the black-rimmed glasses man said, “They seem to be welcoming someone. So many leaders are welcoming that person together… Even the last time when the big leader of Jingbei came, we didn’t make such a big scene out of it.

“This time… I’m afraid it’s a higher-up!”

As the black-rimmed glasses man said this, his eyes flashed faintly.

As a man, he could not help but feel a sense of yearning when facing a big leader.

Qiao Shiya, who was beside him, could not help but look over even more attentively.

At this moment, a tall and handsome figure appeared in the hall.

At the same time, Leibs hurriedly went forward and said excitedly, “Hello, Mr. Lin!”

Then, the leaders above level P7 who were standing neatly shouted in unison, “Welcome, Mr. Lin!”

This scene…

The black-rimmed glasses man was surprised. “Mr. Lin? CEO Lei and the others are actually welcoming such a young man?”

Compared to the black-rimmed glasses man’s surprise, Qiao Shiya was completely stunned.

Lin Fan!

It was Lin Fan!

The CEO of Da Mi Group and the employees above management level P7 were all downstairs to welcome him!

What was his identity?

The black-rimmed glasses man saw that Qiao Shiya had been paying attention to the lobby and thought that she was very curious about the young man who Leibs and the others were welcoming.

Hence, he quickly did a search online on his phone.

“No wonder CEO Lei and the others want to welcome Mr. Lin. Shiya, don’t look at how young Mr. Lin is. He’s actually the largest shareholder of our Da Mi Group!”

When Qiao Shiya heard this, her delicate body trembled slightly.

Lin Fan was the biggest shareholder of Da Mi Group!

How much money would that be?

If…

If… she had agreed to go out with him during the blind date.

Then she would have been the wife of the major shareholder of Da Mi Group.

Now, Leibs and the other leaders were all waiting to welcome Lin Fan!

Thinking of this…

Qiao Shiya was filled with endless regret.

She even shed a tear of regret.
